text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Paging on-call: Elysian (vpc-elysian-prod) is seeing a sudden spike in 429s hitting the dedicated pool. Error rate 18% over 2m, 95th p99 latency stable. Alert: EL-429-TRIAGE-24321.

pagerbot: PagerDuty incident created: PD-89234, priority P1 -> alex oncall. Escalation page to ops-lead in 5 min if not acknowledged.

alex: ack — looking. pulling dashboards now: https://console.redwood/inbox/elysian/dashboards/rate_heatmap

priya: i'm seeing 429s concentrated on /v1/generate with long seqs from a handful of IPs inside their VPC egress. throughput is normal for other tenants.

daniel: confirm dedicated pool isn't CPU saturated — GPU util sitting ~62%, mem fine. KV cache miss rate jumped for elysian keys.

maya: could be noisy tenant behavior inside their VPC set. Have we got tenant isolation rules applied?

alex: isolation rules look correct. hypothesis: customer-side client retries + a misconfigured batching client caused request fanout. Need to limit per-tenant burst while we debug.

priya: can we apply an emergency soft-quota to reduce their concurrent tokens to 60% of contract? that should lower 429 flood to others.

ops-lead: propose two-step mitigation: 1) immediate temporary per-tenant qps cap (soft) + auto-retry header modulation, 2) if still noisy, route a fraction of their traffic to a secondary lower-cost buffer pool.

kevin-cs: heads-up to Elysian CSM, they reported intermittent failures 3m ago. I'll message them and request client logs.

alex: executing soft cap now. CLI:
```
redwood-admin tenant-quota update --tenant elysian --qps 1200 --soft --reason "emergency triage 24321"
```
Response: OK queueing change to edge-configs, will take ~30s to propagate.

priya: seeing immediate drop in inter-tenant 429s. elysian 429s still high but total system stability improving.

daniel: started sampling headers for elysian requests to detect retry loops. sending samples to /tmp/elysian-samples.log.

incident-bot: Note: rollback window 00:30; if mitigation causes customer impact, we will revert.

maya: suggestion: enable per-connection rate-limiter on the gateway for elysian to catch extreme fanout (fast path). Can toggle via feature-flag.

alex: toggling gateway limiter (throttle-per-connection) for elysian now. Command: `feature-flag set gateway.elisian.throttle_conn true` (typo intentionally fixed) — actually correct command:
```
redwood-ff toggle --id gateway.throttle_conn --tenant elysian --on
```
Propagation ok.

kevin-cs: Elysian confirmed they rolled a client change 7m ago. They pushed increased concurrency inadvertently. They're pausing roll now. asking for a short-term exemption while they patch.

ops-lead: we can offer a controlled temporary override but only if it doesn't harm other tenants. proposal: grant a scoped contract override that increases their quota by +20% for 10 minutes to drain in-flight jobs, then auto-expire.

priya: we should be careful — granting +20% might spike again. Better: create a token-based burst drain with token-bucket smoothing: allow higher quota but with 1s refill delay to prevent fanout.

alex: ops, can we spin up a sandbox buffer pool and route 15% of elysian traffic there (non-blocking) so they can complete long-running flows without affecting main pool?

daniel: yep we have a spare small pool in us-west-2. configuring routing rule now: route fraction=0.15 for tenant=elysian -> pool=dedicated-buffer-3. Command: `redwood-route set --tenant elysian --fraction 0.15 --target dedicated-buffer-3`

incident-bot: Routing change queued, will be live in ~45s.

priya: after routing change, 429s for other tenants drop back to baseline. elysian 429s reduced by ~60% where traffic moved to buffer. overall error rate down to 1.8%.

kevin-cs: told customer we applied temporary buffering and gateway throttles; they'll monitor. they appreciate quick response.

ops-lead: good. next steps: 1) create PD follow-up ticket to formalize temporary override (PD-89234 -> TKT-4567), 2) ask eng-runtime to review KV cache behavior for elysian (possible hot keys), 3) schedule postmortem with elysian engineering tomorrow.

alex: created internal ticket: TKT-4567 in ops-board. Assigned to daniel and eng-runtime.

daniel: initial traces show repeated `Accept-Retry: 3` header from same client IPs; looks like exponential backoff misconfigured to aggressive immediate retry. we'll capture a few examples and share.

maya: reminder to log exact commands we ran in incident runbook. also adding note: DO NOT grant manual permanent contract overrides — only short-lived automated expirations.

kevin-cs: Elysian wants a brief outage summary for their execs. I'll draft a client-facing note after we stabilize.

alex: marking incident as mitigated in PagerDuty. PD-89234 -> status: mitigated. closing on-call handoff in 10m.

priya: removing emergency soft-cap and gateway flag is on the checklist once Elysian confirms client patch. leaving buffer route for 30m as safe window.

incident-bot: Incident summary: EL-429-TRIAGE-24321 — root cause: customer client rolled increased concurrency + retry config -> tenant-induced KV cache miss storm causing 429s. Mitigations: soft per-tenant cap, gateway per-connection limiter, 15% route to buffer pool, temporary token-bucket smoothing. Customer engagement: CSM notified, customer paused rollout. Follow-ups: eng-runtime investigation, postmortem with customer, formalize runbook updates.

ops-lead: nice work team. Alex/Priya/Daniel — please prep short postmortem and remediation checklist. Kevin, please coordinate exec note.

kevin-cs: will send preliminary note in ~30m.

alex: on-call sign-off. handing off to daniel for follow-up.

daniel: taking follow-up. closing thread after postmortem scheduled.

kevin-cs: :white_check_mark:
